lcc_original: 永恆主上帝說：『誰告訴你你赤身裸體呢？我吩咐你不可喫的樹上果子，莫非你喫了麼？』
notes: LCC restructures the second question: object clause (我吩咐你不可喫的樹上果子) is fronted before the main verb 喫了, matching Hebrew word order more closely than UNV; all SNs follow accordingly.
{<WAH0834>} placed as implicit tag before 我吩咐你 since it introduces the Hebrew relative clause אֲשֶׁר with no explicit Chinese word in LCC.
UNV {<WAH04480>}那{<WAH04480>}樹 → LCC omits demonstrative 那; both מִן implicit tags are merged together before 樹 since there is no intervening word to separate them.
LCC has a second 你 in 告訴你你赤身裸體 (making the subject of the naked-clause explicit); this pronoun (אָתָּה) has no corresponding SN tag in UNV and is left untagged.
No SN appears for 永恆主上帝 (Yahweh-Elohim) — consistent with UNV, which also has no tag for 耶和華 in this verse, only for the verb 說.
